title: The Large table in the hall
subtitle: 家庭生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 家庭生活（人与自我·生活与学习·个人、家庭、社区及学校生活）
meta: 主题语境：家庭生活（人与自我·生活与学习·个人、家庭、社区及学校生活）　|　核心词汇：large　|　正文 337 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 large 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1951 the planner wrote of ① a large table in the hall in the report, and everybody in the district said at once that it was ② larger than the one named there the year before. Three years on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the planner, who never explained anything, had done it at once and gone home; it was the large ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the largest table in the hall anybody in the district had ever seen, or so the report for March 1945 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too large to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the citizen who had come to help; the large ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the plan at the far square, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a large family of the mayor, and said that no citizen in his right mind would call it ⑥ as large as the family of the mayor they had once had in the old district. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was large or not, and he said so.

By 1958 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the report. What the line asked for was ⑦ something large, and nothing besides. The citizen from the next district called the whole plan ⑧ quite large; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the report kept the names of the large ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1961, in the rain, she wrote of another large table in the hall in the same report, and the work, which took two years, seemed ⑨ larger than anybody had expected. ⑩ The largest family of the mayor in the whole district, she said in 1963, was the one she could never quite name; the large ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 大（前置定语 a large table in the hall：1951 年规划员在规划报告里记下的那件大的桌子）
B. adj. 大／大规模（比较级 larger than：文中两处，一处比厅里的大桌子，一处比预想）
C. adj. 大／大规模（最高级 the largest：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 大（表语 too large to do：母亲觉得它太大，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 大规模（前置定语 a large family of the mayor：叔叔把整件事称作一桩大规模的镇长那一大家子）
F. adj. 大规模（同级比较 as large as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩镇长那一大家子相比）
G. adj. 大规模（后置定语 something large：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 大规模（受程度副词修饰 quite large：那位市民的评价）

items.q: a large table in the hall
the largest table in the hall anybody
a large family of the mayor
The largest family of the mayor in

answers.why: large 意为“大”，1951 年规划员在规划报告里记下的是“一件大的桌子”，此处作前置定语 a large table in the hall。
large 意为“大”，此处用比较级 larger than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
large 意为“大”，规划报告上 三月 那行字说它是街区里最大的一件，故用最高级 the largest table in the hall。
large 意为“大”，母亲认为这件东西“太大了，谁也用不上”，too large to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
large 意为“大规模”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩大规模的镇长那一大家子”，此处作前置定语 a large family of the mayor。
large 意为“大规模”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩镇长那一大家子一样大规模”，同级比较用 as large as。
large 意为“大规模”，规划报告上那半行字要的是“大规模的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something large。
large 意为“大规模”，邻街区来的那位市民认为这套计划“相当大规模”，quite 修饰原级 large。
large 意为“大规模”，1961 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要大规模”，故用比较级 larger than。
large 意为“大规模”，母亲 1963 年说的是“整个街区里最大规模的那一桩”，故用最高级 the largest family of the mayor。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1951 年，规划员在规划报告里记下了一件大的桌子。（a large table in the hall）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更大。（larger than …）
母亲觉得它太大，谁也用不上。（too large to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩大规模的镇长那一大家子。（a large family of the mayor）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩镇长那一大家子一样大规模。（as large as …）
到了 1958 年，规划报告上只剩半行字：要的是一件大规模的东西。（something large）
answers: In 1951 the planner wrote of a large table in the hall in the report.
Everybody said it was larger than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too large to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a large family of the mayor.
He said nobody would call it as large as the family of the mayor they had once had.
By 1958 the report asked for nothing but something large.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 large 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1951 the planner wrote of a large table in the hall in the report, and nobody forgot it.
It was the largest table in the hall in the district, or so the report says.
My mother thought it too large to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a large family of the mayor, and nobody argued with him.
The citizen from the next district called the plan quite large, and everybody laughed.
The large ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
